SHAREPASS / DESK PROCEDURE

At the desk

01

Receive & store

Count Normal, VIP and VVIP passes. Store one packet in a fresh shelf slot. Write its packet ID on the envelope; keep the shared code private.

02

Verify & release

Verify the code for each new pickup. Match the physical packet ID. Select the exact categories, record the release, then confirm handover. The same code can collect the balance later.

03

Share privately

Anyone with the shared code can collect all remaining passes. There are no individual allocations or named collectors. Show or read the code quietly; WhatsApp sharing is optional and manual. No printed receipt.

04

If a handover is unclear

A recorded release has already reduced the balance. Reopen that packet to review the reserved quantities and physical stock. Confirm the existing handover once; never create a replacement release. If unsure, stop for supervisor review.

Example packet & practice controls

Shelf A-01 · 6 Normal / 2 VIP / 1 VVIP · Code K7M4

Practice only. Fictional Oktoberfest 2027. Four-character codes are not secure authorization. Reload clears records; no device sync. No real passes or personal data.
WHO IS AT THE DESK?

Set your staff label

An audit label only, not an authenticated identity. Use a practice staff label.
01 / TAKE CUSTODY

New deposit

Count the passes by category. Store them in one packet at a fresh shelf slot.

Use a fresh shelf slot. At least one pass required, maximum 100 per category. The packet ID and private code are generated on save.
01 / VERIFY CODE

Verify collection code

Use the private code shared by the depositor. A packet ID cannot authorize pickup.

Anyone with this code can collect any remaining passes. Keep it private.
